# hush_cloudinary_access_credential (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a Cloudinary access credential in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_cloudinary_access_credential" "example" {
  id = "acr-eu12345678"
}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.hush_cloudinary_access_credential.example.account_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Cloudinary access credential

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The Cloudinary account ID, as **Settings > Account Management Keys** shows it: 1 to 128 letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Changing it requires a new `api_key` and a new `api_secret` (or bumped `api_key_wo_version` and `api_secret_wo_version`)
- `deployment_ids` (List of String) List of deployment IDs that can access this credential. Currently limited to a single deployment
- `description` (String) The description of the Cloudinary access credential
- `kind` (String) The kind of access credential
- `name` (String) The name of the Cloudinary access credential
- `secret_store_id` (String) The ID of the secret store where this credential is saved (optional)
- `type` (String) The type of access credential
